main_text.head: NUNCUPATORIA.
main_text.p: proventum uberiorem, felici-orémque profiteri, juxtà ac promovere.

Ad vos tandem redeo (Viri clarissimi) quorum interest prospicere, non modò nè cæremonias, veluti Ecclesiæ phylacteria, improbè quis arroserit: sed multò etiam magis, nè articulos ejus, tanquam spiritus vitales, eliserit. Ex his facilè intelligatis cur vobis hoc, quicquid est opellæ, nunc dico, consecróque. In qua causam hanc uberiùs differui, ut facilius effugerem Adversariorum calumniam, præsertim cùm (ut scitè cautéque Cicero) Quæ angustiùs & breviùs concluduntur, ea ferè apertiora & aptiora sunt ad

page.notes: The ornament ¶¶¶ below the text is a printer's ornament, not a word, and is not transcribed in the text. "arroserit" and "orémque" are read from a slightly blurred scan; the accents on "orémque", "consecróque" and "cautéque" are as far as I can see them. The catchword "ad" is the first word of the next page. The line "ea ferè apertiora & aptiora sunt" is set in italic.
